title: Bounded TABLECONTENT column/table-scope margin writer

scope.operation: Serialize one column-scope or table-scope TABLEFORMAT margin override in a rectangular TABLECONTENT grid.
scope.profile: Generated 2x2 AC1027 scalar table: one type-3 column style or one type-4 table style carries the selected margin-only profile. ASCII and binary DXF.
scope.source_basis: The current decoder in src/intern/dxftablecontent.h retains separate type-3 formatted-column and type-4 table scopes, each with the six-value CELLMARGIN payload. Before this change, the multi-cell writer rejected nondefault column and table styles and emitted defaults. This receipt qualifies only generated serializer profiles; it is not a producer-authored source or native-rendering witness.
limits: One selected type-3 column style or one type-4 table style
The second column remains default in the column profile
All six margins are finite and nonnegative
No borders, content-format, custom-data, CELLSTYLEMAP, or other style properties
scope.claim_boundary: Selected DXF serializer and typed readback evidence only; no independent producer, native CAD rendering, or DWG output claim.

implementation: Generalize the selected margin-only style admission to type-3 column and type-4 table scopes while retaining cell and row profiles.
Validate every column scope and the table scope before emitting the multi-cell object.
Emit the selected type-3 style in COLUMNTABLEFORMAT and the selected type-4 style in TABLEFORMAT.

physical_wire: The type-3 profile emits two column TABLEFORMAT records: the selected first column has data and margin flag 1 with exactly six ordered group-40 values; the sibling column stays default.
The type-4 profile emits the selected TABLEFORMAT with data and margin flag 1 and exactly six ordered group-40 values.
evidence.typed_readback: Fresh imports preserve the selected scope type, has-data state, override flag and all six margins for both column and table profiles.
evidence.failure_control: A negative horizontal margin is refused; the existing destination sentinel, caller metadata and table collection remain unchanged.
evidence.retry_control: Restoring the original positive margin permits export on the same adapter; fresh readback returns the selected margin value.

remaining: The parent P5 rendering/TABLE phase remains open.
This receipt does not qualify other column/table style properties, alternate scope compositions, CELLSTYLEMAP, native rendering, or DWG output.
